### 🚀 v1.1.0 Release Notes — 🛡️ Goofish (Xianyu / 闲鱼) All-in-One Seller Profiles, Zhima Credit, Inventory & Reviews Scraper + Standby API (`$1 / 1K`)

Cookieless Goofish / Xianyu (闲鱼) All-in-One Seller Intelligence, Zhima Credit (芝麻信用) Verification, Storefront Inventory (`selling` & `sold`), and Historical Buyer Reviews Scraper + Synchronous Standby REST API (`unitbytes--goofish-scraper.apify.actor`) on Apify (`$1.00 / 1,000 reviews`).

- 🔧 **9-Node n8n Automation Workflows:** Ready-to-import `.json` templates under `n8n/` and at **[unitbytes.com/n8n](https://unitbytes.com/n8n/)**.

- **Zero Login or Cookies Required:** Operates 100% anonymously without personal accounts or session tokens.
